required_assumptions: T is an uninterpreted binary function symbol.
i and j are placeholder symbols that can be assigned to either slot.

The shared latent object is the binary function template T(a,b); the two members are its two specializations corresponding to the two permutations of the parameter pair. This directly matches the observed PERMUTATION_RELATED and SUBSTITUTION_INSTANCE relations.
